nodes.body_text: The imaginary laboratory records three samples without using personal records. Each sample has a readable description and a value in its original written form. The identifier 0012 names a series, while −7 records a signed change. The decimal point in 123.45 remains part of the observation. A revision can correct a transcription only while retaining the original document and a reason for the change.
